title: Halvorsen vulnerability backlog
brief: Halvorsen Retail's security team wants a short weekly page on the vulnerability backlog, week 42 (ending 2026-10-16). Right now there are 3 open critical findings, 41 open highs and 188 open mediums. Patch SLA compliance is 91.5 percent against a 95 percent target, and the median age of an open critical is 6 days. Open highs over the last six weeks: W37 63, W38 58, W39 52, W40 49, W41 44, W42 41. Under "Critical findings", the three criticals with owner and due date: VULN-8812, remote code execution in the image-resize library, Tobias Lind, due 2026-10-18; VULN-8830, exposed admin console on a staging server, Nadia Haddad, due 2026-10-17; VULN-8841, outdated TLS on the POS gateway, Reggie Okoye, due 2026-10-23. VULN-8841 is the risky one because it touches store payment terminals and needs a change window, so say so clearly. Keep it brief.

edit.request: VULN-8830 was fixed this morning, so drop it from the page entirely, but a new critical was found: VULN-8850, expired certificate on the loyalty API, owner Mei-Lin Zhao, due 2026-10-21. The open critical count stays at 3, and the median age of an open critical is now 7 days.
